title: Hyaluronic acid-based corneal epithelium-mimicking coating for therapeutic contact lenses to manage dry eye disease and prevent bacterial keratitis.
abstract: Dry eye disease (DED) is a common ocular surface disorder characterized by tear-film instability and an increased risk of bacterial keratitis (BK). Inspired by the hydrophilic glycocalyx of native corneal epithelium with intrinsic antibacterial activity, we developed a corneal epithelium-mimicking hydrogel coating for therapeutic contact lenses (CLs) to manage DED and prevent BK. The HA/DC coating was fabricated via a mild, one-pot cross-linking of hyaluronic acid (HA) and the antibacterial silane coupling agent DC5700, forming a robust, hydrophilic, and lubricious network firmly anchored on CL surfaces. The designed HA/DC hydrogel coating exhibited a significantly reduced Young's modulus (0.19 MPa) compared with the pristine CL (6.53 MPa), thus showing a high degree of corneal epithelium biomimicry with matching mechanical compliance, while delivering enhanced oxygen permeability (41.7 Barrer) and contact-active antibacterial activity. Hence, in a rabbit DED model, these biomimetic features enable the HA/DC-coated CLs to promote corneal epithelial healing, recover goblet cell density, and prolong tear film breakup time, thereby restoring tear-film stability comparable to that in healthy rabbits. The coating also inhibited biofilm formation during 14-day bacterial exposure in vitro and demonstrated prophylactic efficacy in a rat infection model. authors: Wu Chengcheng; Wu Jinchuan; Li Kaijun et al.
summary_zh: 研究開發透明角膜上皮仿生水凝膠塗層（HA/DC），應用於治療性隱形眼鏡以管理乾眼症及預防細菌性角膜炎。該塗層具低楊氏模數(0.19 MPa)、高透氧性(41.7 Barrer)及接觸型抗菌活性，在兔乾眼模型中促進角膜上皮癒合並恢復淚膜穩定性，在體外14日菌膜暴露試驗中有效抑制生物膜形成。
highlight: HA/DC水凝膠塗層透過仿生設計實現機械合規性、生物相容性與抗菌活性的整合，為醫療器材表面改質的創新策略。

title: Moisture-Balanced Antibacterial Dressings Promote Wound Healing by Maintaining a Modulating Microenvironment.
abstract: Wound healing depends on a suitable microenvironment and infection control. However, existing dressings fail to meet the needs of moisture balance and antibacterial properties at the same time. In this study, we synthesized a moisture-balancing antibacterial dressing, polyurethane@polydopamine@silver(PU@PDA@Ag), by soaking dopamine-coated polyurethane (PU@PDA) in a silver nitrate solution. The performance of the dressing was then evaluated in vitro and in vivo. In vitro experiments revealed that compared with nonwoven fabrics and hydrogels, PU@PDA@Ag2.5 prepared with 2.5 mg/mL silver nitrate had excellent moisture absorption-water retention performance (a swelling rate of 1000% for 1 h and a water retention rate of 481.69% for 6 h). SEM, EDS, and FTIR confirmed that the silver nanoparticles were loaded uniformly by PDA, the porous structure of PU was not destroyed, the water contact angle decreased to 60.6°, and the hydrophilicity improved. authors: Peng Yuan; Li Xue; Zhang Can et al.
summary_zh: 本研究開發聚氨酯@聚多巴胺@銀(PU@PDA@Ag)複合敷料，通過多巴胺塗層聚氨酯浸泡硝酸銀製備。該敷料展現優異的保濕與吸水性能(1小時膨脹率1000%、6小時保水率481.69%)，具均勻分散的銀奈米顆粒、改善的親水性(接觸角60.6°)、良好生物相容性及強效抗菌活性(金黃色葡萄球菌抑菌圈113.8mm²、大腸桿菌94.7mm²)。
highlight: 多巴胺聚合物前處理結合金屬銀奈米粒子可同時實現優異的親水性與抗菌性，技術方向與Bioteque導管塗層改質策略相近。

title: Surface Engineering of NiTi via Ta
authors: Kolasa Julia; Taratuta Anna; Rynkus Barbara et al.
summary_zh: 本研究探討氧化鉭（Ta₂O₅）表面工程技術對鎳鈦合金（NiTi）的改質效果。氧化鉭具有優異的生物相容性和親水性，可通過物理沉積或化學方法在NiTi表面形成保護層，改善生物醫學應用中的潤濕性、耐腐蝕性和抗血栓性能。該方法對血管支架、導管等醫療器材的表面改質具有潛在應用價值。
highlight: 氧化鉭親水塗層可直接改善NiTi基醫療器材的表面潤濕性，有助降低摩擦係數並提升生物相容性。

title: Intrinsically disordered protein condensate-based coating on ureteral stents for anti-fouling and anti-encrustation.
abstract: Ureteral stents are among the most frequently used devices in urology, yet their high susceptibility to biofilm and encrustation continues to evade current surface-coating strategies. The development of emerging coatings faces significant challenges due to the complex physiological environment of the urinary tract, featuring high salinity, continuous shear stress, fluctuating pH, and microbial contamination. authors: Deng Bo-Dan; Mo Wen-Hao; Zhang Zhi-Jun et al.
summary_zh: 研究開發基於內在無序蛋白質凝聚物（FUS蛋白）的尿管支架塗層，針對生物膜和結石沉積問題。該策略通過蛋白質凝聚物工程應對尿道複雜環境（高鹽、剪切應力、pH波動、微生物汙染），為現有塗層技術提供創新解決方案。
highlight: 首次將內在無序蛋白質凝聚物應用於尿管支架抗污防結石塗層，直接解決Bioteque核心產品的臨床痛點。

title: Functionally graded bilayer polyurethane sponge with sequential stage-adaptive capabilities for full-cycle repair of infected wounds.
abstract: The management of full-thickness infected wounds remains a major clinical challenge, largely due to the paucity of multifunctional dressings capable of stage-adaptive regulation across the entire healing cascade. To address this need, we developed a functionally graded bilayer polyurethane composite sponge. The upper layer was fabricated by chemical foaming combined with dopamine-assisted reduction, producing a hydrophobic macroporous sponge bearing a polydopamine coating and loaded with silver nanoparticles (PUF@P-Ag). The lower layer was a hydrophilic microporous polyurethane sponge (PUS) prepared by freeze-drying, which provided rapid hemostasis and controllable degradability. During the hemostatic phase, the PUS layer concentrated blood components to promote efficient clot formation and subsequently underwent rapid degradation. In the inflammatory phase, the acidic microenvironment generated by PUS degradation acted synergistically with sustained silver ion release from the upper layer and near-infrared photothermal effects, thereby establishing a triple antibacterial system. Concurrently, the polydopamine coating alleviated local oxidative stress. As healing progresses into the proliferation phase, a sustained weakly acidic milieu supported endothelial cell proliferation and angiogenesis. authors: Wang Qiusheng; Mai Chongyang; Li Yue et al.
summary_zh: 研究開發一種功能梯度雙層聚氨酯複合海綿，用於感染傷口全週期修復。上層為疏水多孔海綿，含聚多巴胺塗層與銀奈米顆粒；下層為親水微孔海綿，提供止血與可控降解。該系統通過酸性微環境、銀離子釋放與光熱效應形成三重抗菌機制，並支持內皮細胞增殖。動物實驗證實其階段自適應特性顯著加速傷口癒合。
highlight: 雙層聚氨酯設計與多功能塗層系統（聚多巴胺、銀奈米粒子）的階段自適應特性，提供了醫療器材表面改質的創新思路。

title: Achieving bacteria eradication on titanium implants: synergistic effect of tannic acid coating and levofloxacin.

Tannic acid (TA) coatings offer a promising strategy to prevent IRIs owing to their antibacterial properties. TA binds strongly to metal oxide surfaces, forming stable self-assembled layers. authors: Cajiao Checchin Valentina Chiara; Miñán Alejandro; Prieto Eduardo et al.
summary_zh: 研究開發鞣酸(TA)塗層與左氧氟沙星(LEV)協同作用於鈦植入物表面，預防植入物相關感染。TA通過自組裝形成穩定塗層，結合低劑量抗生素實現細菌根除。該方法簡便有效，但產品應用領域(骨科植入物)與Bioteque導尿管、透析導管等血管內器材差異大。
highlight: 鞣酸自組裝塗層與抗生素協同的表面改質策略展示穩定性與抗菌效能，但應用於鈦基骨科植入物而非聚氨酯血管內導管。

title: Epigallocatechin gallate-loaded alginate-peanut protein hydrogel beads: Influence of pectin-based crosslinking and chitosan-based coating strategies.
abstract: Epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) exhibits potent antioxidant capacity along with multiple health-promoting bioactivities; however, its low bioavailability has limited its practical application. In this study, composite hydrogel beads were fabricated using sodium alginate (SA) and peanut protein isolate (PPI) as the primary matrix materials, and EGCG was encapsulated via two distinct strategies: blending low-methoxy pectin (LMP) with SA for calcium ion-induced multiple cross-linking, and combining quaternized chitosan (QC) with SA through interfacial layer-by-layer self-assembly to create an electrostatic coating. Both aimed to improve EGCG stability during digestion and enhance its functionality. The results demonstrated that the incorporation of LMP and QC both enhanced the mechanical properties of the hydrogel beads (P < 0.05), with hydrogen bonding and electrostatic interactions serving as the primary forces driving gel formation. LMP addition reduced encapsulation efficiency (EE), whereas QC enhanced it; the highest EE (74.23%) was achieved at 0.5% QC. Under simulated gastrointestinal conditions, the beads demonstrated pH-responsive behavior: EGCG release was slow in gastric fluid (25.1%-44.3%) but increased sharply in intestinal fluid. Overall, QC-modified SA-PPI composite hydrogel beads represent a promising carrier platform with significant potential for targeted intestinal delivery of hydrophilic bioactives such as EGCG.
authors: Wang Yuwei; Wang Xuefei; Zhu Yuchen et al.
summary_zh: 研究開發含綠茶兒茶素的海藻酸鈉-花生蛋白水凝膠珠，採用果膠和殼聚糖交聯及涂層策略提升機械強度與載藥穩定性。殼聚糖修飾組達74.23%包封效率，在模擬胃腸環境中展現pH應答性釋放行為，具腸靶向遞送潛力，但應用領域為食品/藥物，非醫療器材表面改質。
highlight: 殼聚糖涂層通過靜電相互作用顯著提升機械性能與載體包封效率，但該系統應用於食品/藥物遞送而非器材表面改質。

title: Enhanced bioelectricity generation and Cr(VI) removal with polydopamine-functionalized carboxylated carbon nanotubes as high-performance anode electrocatalyst.
abstract: Cr(VI) with high redox potential, can be effectively reduced using microbial fuel cell (MFC). High-performance bioanodes play a crucial role in enhancing both power generation and Cr(VI) removal. In this study, carbon nanotubes were modified via a sequential two-step strategy combining covalent acid oxidation and polydopamine (PDA) non-covalent coating. Systematic evaluation verified that polydopamine-functionalized carboxylated carbon nanotube (POC) was a highly efficient anode modification material for MFCs. The POC modified carbon brush (POC/CB) improved the surface morphology of carbon fibers and introduced abundant functional groups and catalytically active sites, thereby significantly enhancing the hydrophilicity, biocompatibility, and electrochemical activity of carbon brushes. authors: Guo Wei; Wang Jiayi; Zhao Yongchao et al.
summary_zh: 本研究開發聚多巴胺功能化羧基化碳奈米管（POC）作為微生物燃料電池陽極修飾材料，通過酸氧化與非共價聚多巴胺塗層的二步策略改善碳刷表面形貌、增加官能基團與催化活性位點，顯著提升親水性、生物相容性與電化學活性，達到23.5 W/m²最大功率密度。研究聚焦於能源轉換與Cr(VI)去除應用。
highlight: 聚多巴胺非共價塗層策略可增強碳質材料親水性與生物相容性，但主要應用為能源領域而非醫療器材表面改質。
